meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (mainland unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code tradition; unitary national commercial code; EU-derived regulatory framework)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Convention between France and China for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion (signed 26 Nov 2013; in force 28 Dec 2014)
France-People's Republic of China Agreement on the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (signed 30 May 1984; in force 1985)
EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (signed 30 Dec 2020; pending ratification and not yet in force)
France-United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (in force 31 Dec 1995) - relevant for US-linked structuring

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier - CMF), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-59 and R.561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obliged-entity regime); CMF Article L.561-45 (obligation to identify beneficial owners); CMF Article L.561-46 (filing of beneficial owner declaration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); Décret n° 2017-632 of 25 Apr 2017 (UBO register implementing decree); Décret n° 2018-284 of 18 Apr 2018; Arrêté of 25 Jun 2017 prescribing the UBO declaration form; French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) Articles L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-4; Ordonnance n° 2020-115 of 12 Feb 2020 transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5). Public access to the French UBO register is restricted following CJEU Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 (22 Nov 2022).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - access limited to competent authorities (Tracfin, DGFiP, customs), AML/CFT obliged entities performing customer due diligence, and persons demonstrating a legitimate interest; no open public consultation of the UBO register is available.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport (or EU/EEA ID card) of each ultimate beneficial owner and SAS President
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary or public authority of the country of origin (e.g., PRC Ministry of Public Security / local notary office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs (apostille effective 7 Nov 2023 since China's accession to the 1961 Hague Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO (utility bill, bank statement or notarized affidavit)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company, credit institution or notary in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - PRC MFA or apostille authority of the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / KYC confirmation for each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign credit institution of the UBO (issued under the bank's KYC data)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - apostille authority of the bank's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing (extrait de registre / good standing certificate) for any direct or indirect corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial register or company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - apostille authority of the issuing registry; consular legalization required only for non-Hague states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney (POA) authorizing the French incorporation agent/avocat to file the registration and sign ancillary declarations
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary of the UBO's country of residence (bilingual French/Chinese or French/English version)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - PRC MFA or apostille authority of the notarization venue

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional CV or business résumé of the SAS President and UBOs (corporate substance evidence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille - notarization followed by apostille in the signatory's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening under FATF Recommendations 12 and 22 and Directive (EU) 2018/843. The French AML/CFT framework (CMF Art. L.561-10) requires: (1) determination of PEP status of the UBOs, President and intermediaries; (2) enhanced due diligence for any PEP on identity source-of-wealth and source-of-funds; (3) sanctions screening against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List (Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 and CFSP annexes), the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List (best practice for US-payment-rail exposure), and French national asset-freezing orders (arrêtés de gel des avoirs issued under CMF Art. L.562-2 by the Ministère de l'Économie). Tracfin reporting obligations apply under CMF Art. L.561-15 for any suspicious transaction. Continuous monitoring and negative-news review are recommended for low-risk MarTech SaaS because US payment processors (Stripe, Paddle) enforce their own OFAC-based restrictions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique électronique des formalités d'entreprises (official government portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by the Direction interministérielle du numérique (DINUM); the underlying national registry is the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) administered by INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle). Name clearance is performed at filing, with an advisory pre-search against the RNE/INPI database and the EU trademarks database (EUIPO).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: French is the mandatory language of all corporate and filing documents under the Toubon Law (Loi n° 94-665 of 4 Aug 1994) and French Commercial Code Art. L.123-1-1. The corporate name must be in Roman (Latin) script; non-Latin names require a transliteration and a French rendering must appear as an equivalent. The legal form designation 'Société par actions simplifiée' or the abbreviation 'SAS' must be stated after the corporate name in all legal documents and on the Kbis extract. Names must be legally available, distinctive, and must not violate public policy or morality (Art. R.123-54 C.com).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France operates a first-to-file system, not a formal statutory name-reservation regime; the 30-day window reflects the practical validity of an RNE/INPI availability pre-search before refiling. Procedure upon rejection: (1) obtain the formal refusal grounds from the Greffe/RNE notification issued through the Guichet unique; (2) adopt a remedial shareholders' extra-judicial decision amending the corporate name to remove conflicting or prohibited tokens; (3) refile the corrected registration via the Guichet unique (fees are retained on name-refusal only if the filing package is incomplete; a name-only correction incurs no additional statutory fee); (4) if the dispute concerns a trademark or registered-domain conflict, file an opposition or invalidity action before INPI (opposition deadline within 2 months of publication); (5) judicial review is available before the competent Tribunal judiciaire (commercial division) under general administrative litigation rules governing RNE refusals. A complete re-submission with a revised name normally resolves more than 95% of first-instance refusals within 3 to 5 business days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible and routinely accepted for low-risk SaaS/MarTech activities under Article L.123-11-1 of the French Commercial Code: the registered office of an SAS may be domiciled at a business incubator or an approved domiciliation company for a maximum of two consecutive agreements (total 5 years), with mandatory publication and renewal declarations. Pure 'postal-only' virtual offices without operational capability are legally ineffective where the DGFiP raises the abuse-of-domiciliation doctrine (Art. L.123-11-4 C.com). Recommended structure: an RNE-listed business center with physical meeting facilities, mail handling, and corporate seat signage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified at approximately 3% per annum for a low-risk SEO analytics SaaS entity with minimal VAT recovery and no disclosed operating losses. The probability increases to 10-15% per annum if the company claims substantial VAT refunds, reports consecutive losses, or operates from a pure virtual office without verifiable substance. Key inspection triggers for DGFiP and URSSAF: inconsistency between declared activity and registered office address, absence of the actual president at the domiciliation address, and excessive foreign-facing service invoices.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official name availability search and INPI/RNE database pre-clearance report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle) via a licensed corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a single name-search and screening report (USD 70 - USD 150 per report)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified legal drafting of SAS articles of association (statuts) and corporate governance annexes by an Avocat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent avocat registered with the Paris Bar
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for SAS incorporation (USD 900 - USD 1,800 flat fee including client onboarding and constitutional documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified court-registered legal translation (Chinese/English to French) of UBO, corporate and constitutional documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Court-certified legal translator (expert traducteur inscrit auprès de la cour d'appel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market standard of USD 70 - USD 90 per 1,000 words; estimated 10,000-word bundle, inclusive of notarization of translation consistency

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille bundle for foreign UBO/corporate documents (6 documents at PRC MFA statutory rate plus agency coordination)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China (Consular Department) / provincial Foreign Affairs Commissions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory PRC MFA tariff of approximately RMB 120 (USD 15 - USD 20) per document, plus moderate agent handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the legal announcement of incorporation (avis de constitution) in an official legal gazette (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized legal announcement publisher
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate fixed by ministerial decree; typical USD 170 - USD 220 per insertion for a standard SAS constitution notice

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) registration filing via the Guichet unique (immatriculation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / Registre National des Entreprises (collected via the Guichet unique platform)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory non-negotiable tariff of EUR 56.40 (2024 rate) for SAS creation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office / domiciliation in a licensed and RNE-approved business center (first 12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RNE-approved domiciliation company (domiciliataire agréé) under Art. L.123-11-1 to L.123-11-3 C.com
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 100 - USD 140 per month including mail reception, meeting-room access and annual certificate of domiciliation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Blocked-capital deposit account opening and certificate of deposit release by a French credit institution
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French credit institution (deposit-taking banque) or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevalent bank fee of USD 120 - USD 250 for the capital block certificate issued upon incorporation and release

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title II, Chapter VII — Articles L.227-1 to L.227-32 (Société par Actions Simplifiée regime); Articles L.225-127 to L.225-144 (share subscription and capital payment rules applicable via Article L.227-2); Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general formation provisions); Decree No. 2007-431 of 25 March 2007; Articles R.123-1 and R.123-30 et seq. (RCS immatriculation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) keeping the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS); electronic filings are submitted via the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr and are routed to the competent registry based on the registered office location.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier unique de demande d'immatriculation (single-window creation file) composed of the executed Statuts (Articles of Association), attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital deposit certificate issued by a bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts), attestation de parution d'un avis de constitution au Journal d'Annonces Légales, the declaration of beneficial ownership (bénéficiaires effectifs), and the lease or attestation of the registered office (attestation de jouissance).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum statutory capital for an SAS; the articles set the capital freely. The full capital must be subscribed before registration and at least 50% of the nominal value of cash contributions must be paid up at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years (Article L.225-129 alt. via L.227-2). Cash must be escrowed in a blocked account opened in the company's name at a French bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary's account; the deposit certificate is filed with the RCS and funds are released only upon registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER OF [COMPANY] SAS. Adopted on [date] by the sole shareholder of the company in formation. RESOLVED: (1) The subscriptions to the Company's share capital of EUR [amount], divided into [number] shares of EUR [par value] each, are approved; (2) The Statuts dated [date] are ratified; (3) The registered office is fixed at [address], France; (4) [Name] is appointed President of the Company with full powers to bind the Company, open bank accounts, and complete all registration formalities; (5) The publication of the legal notice and the filing of the dossier with the Guichet Unique are authorized. Certified by the President.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Statuts (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders acting directly; a notary is required only if real property is contributed or if the founders opt for notarial form
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Statuts in French containing all mandatory items: corporate name, legal form (SAS), registered office, corporate purpose (computer programming and SaaS — SEO content analytics tools, ISIC 6201), duration (99 years), share capital, share classes and rights, presidency and governance powers, and dispute resolution. All shareholders must sign the final version; signatures may be handwritten or electronic (eIDAS-compliant). If contributions in kind exceed EUR 30,000 or exceed half the capital, appoint a commissaire aux apports to value and report before signature.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts in original or electronic form
Identity documents of all shareholders and officers
Declaration of beneficial ownership (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
Report of the commissaire aux apports, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry later queries a statutory clause, adopt a supplementary rectification act (acte de régularisation) signed by the same shareholders and resubmit; no fee is incurred for a mere regulatory correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked cash capital deposit (dépôt de fonds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French commercial bank, Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or notary escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the company in formation ('[Company] SAS en formation') and remit at least 50% of the nominal value of each cash share subscription. The depositary issues the attestation de dépôt des fonds listing the shareholders and amounts received. The funds are blocked until the RCS registration certificate (K-bis) is obtained, at which point they are released to the Company's legal representative.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts
List of subscribers with amounts and subscription forms
KYC/anti-money laundering documents of the subscribers (identity, source of funds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank refuses the deposit due to incomplete KYC, complete the beneficial-ownership declarations or switch to a notary escrow; the attestation must be reissued in the exact name of the company in formation to avoid registration rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish an avis de constitution containing the corporate name, legal form, capital amount, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, and identity of the President. Obtain the attestation de parution from the JAL within 1-2 days of insertion; this proof must be attached to the registration file.
required_dossiers: Draft avis de constitution text
Copy of the Statuts
Payment receipt of the insertion fee (EUR 65-280 depending on selected JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requires corrections, publish an amended legal notice and obtain a new attestation covering the corrected version; never submit the file with a stale or contradictory notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of the President and corporate governance decisions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole shareholder or shareholders' meeting acting as the corporate body of the SAS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the appointment decision for the President (and, if desired, a Director General / Directeur Général). The decision must record the President's civil identity, date of birth, French or foreign address, and acceptance of office. Confirm in writing the President's remuneration policy, daily bank signing authorities, and any internal governance rules (e.g., director general delegation).
required_dossiers: Written decision of the sole shareholder or minutes of the shareholders' meeting
President's acceptance letter and identity document
Proof of address of the President
Pacte d'associés (shareholders' agreement), if executed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the appointed President is disqualified or refuses the office, adopt a replacement appointment before filing; a missing or invalid president appointment renders the RCS application voidable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic submission of the creation dossier via the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (INPI) with transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the account on formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, complete the 'création d'entreprise' questionnaire (Form N equivalent), upload all statutory documents and the supporting dossiers, and pay the greffe fees online. The system issues an acknowledgment of receipt; the responsible registry reviews the file and either registers the company or issues a request for completion.
required_dossiers: Executed Statuts
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital certificate)
Attestation de parution au Journal d'Annonces Légales
Lease agreement or attestation de jouissance for the registered office
Identity and address of officers and shareholders
Declaration of beneficial ownership
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a demande de complément, respond with the missing documents within the statutory deadline (usually 15 working days); do not create a new application. If statutory clauses are formally deficient, adopt and upload a rectification act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the K-bis, capital release, and post-registration activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS registration certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, the Company obtains its K-bis extract, RCS number, SIRET/SIREN identifiers, and APE/NAF code 6201Z. The Registrar notifies the depositary to release the blocked capital. Immediately afterwards: register with URSSAF for employer obligations (DSN), obtain a VAT identification number, open the definitive professional bank account, and arrange for the company seal. No industry operating permit is required for software activity.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract (issued automatically)
Bank account details for capital release
Officer identity documents for URSSAF registration
NAF code 6201Z confirmation (automatic)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis contains errors (corporate name, capital, officers, or NAF code), file a written rectification request with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; the correction is processed within a few days and a reissued K-bis is provided.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DRIEAT (Île-de-France) / DREAL (regional environmental directorate) under the Ministry of Ecological Transition; not applicable to the non-industrial SaaS activity, as software and SEO analytics tools are office-based tertiary services outside the ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) nomenclature.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial operating or manufacturing permit is required for ISIC 6201 (computer programming and SEO content analytics tool); the activity is a professional service with no physical production plant, no machinery, and no classified installation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL/DRIEAT (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement) and ADEME (Agence de la transition écologique) for waste registration obligations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the tertiary office activity falls outside the ICPE registration and full EIA report categories (Code de l'environnement, Annex to Article R.511-9); no environmental authorization or environmental impact assessment is required for formation. The company must still observe general waste-management duties under Articles L.541-1 et seq., including sorting and recycling channels.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or combustion emission thresholds apply to office-based software activity. Applicable obligations: (i) compliance with municipal waste sorting by-laws and the DEEE (e-waste) recycling stream under Articles R.543-178 et seq. for any IT hardware; (ii) if the company hosts physical servers on its own premises (expected: no, cloud-hosted SaaS), DEEE and cooling-system reporting would apply; (iii) greenhouse-gas reporting obligations under Article L.229-25 only trigger above 500 employees, which is not applicable at formation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: for private office premises not open to the public, comply with the Code du travail workplace safety provisions (Articles R.4227-1 to R.4227-50 — extinguishers, alarm and evacuation procedures). If part of the premises is open to the public (ERP 5th category), a declaration to the local Mairie and a fire safety commission visit are required before occupancy. Occupational clearance: draft and register the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUERP), arrange workplace medical fitness visits for employees, obtain the lessor's structural load confirmation, and verify electrical installation compliance certificates for the leased office; employer registration with URSSAF is mandatory once staff are hired.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the Impôts.gouv.fr professional portal
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SAS obtains its statutory identity numbers (SIREN, SIRET, and registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés) through the statutory formalities portal. The entities.gouv.fr / formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr single window files the incorporation dossier, which is transmitted to the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) and the Commercial Court Registry. VAT identification (numéro d'identification à la TVA) is subsequently issued by the DGFiP upon confirmation of the RCS registration. A foreign entity not yet established in France but making taxable supplies must apply directly to the DGFiP Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE) using the standard VAT registration form, appointing a tax representative (représentant fiscal) if required by Article 289 CGI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: French law does not provide a check-the-box election. An SAS is automatically subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés) on its worldwide profits if its place of effective management is in France. Available statutory elections include: (i) group tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI for French-resident parent companies holding at least 95% of subsidiaries; (ii) election to apply a reduced corporate income tax rate for small-company profits under Article 219 CGI; (iii) option for non-resident-company permanent establishments to file separate French branch accounts; and (iv) anti-hybrid elections and notifications required under Article 212 bis CGI as transposing ATAD rules on hybrid mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: France applies no registration threshold for foreign suppliers of B2B or B2C digital services; registration is required from the first euro of taxable turnover in France. For French-established small businesses, the franchise en base de TVA threshold is €85,000 for goods and €37,500 for services, but such franchise is not available to foreign taxable persons supplying digital services. The EU One-Stop Shop (OSS) and Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) regimes may replace separate French VAT registration for distance sales and low-value import consignments.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is phasing in mandatory electronic invoicing and electronic reporting for domestic B2B transactions. From 1 September 2026, a e-invoicing obligation applies to large and mid-size enterprises; from 1 September 2027 it extends to small enterprises and micro-enterprises. Invoices must be issued and transmitted in a structured electronic format (Factur-X, PEPPOL BIS, EDI, or a public portal format) through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or an accredited Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire (PDP). No real-time cryptographic stamping or iterative clearance model (à la Italy or France's early e-invoice pilot) is in force, but transaction-level e-reporting data is transmitted periodically to the DGFiP through the PPF/PDP APIs within legally prescribed deadlines. Foreign suppliers operating under the OSS regime are required to maintain detailed records and may be subject to mandatory e-reporting for B2B supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export zero-rating is available under Article 262-I-1° CGI for goods physically transported outside the European Union by the seller or on its behalf, provided the exporter holds evidence of the transport and the customs export declaration. Services qualify for zero-rating under Article 259-1 CGI where they are B2B services supplied to a customer established outside the EU, including software-as-a-service, data analytics, and SEO content analytics tools, provided the services are not physically performed in France. The supplier must retain documentary proof of customer identity, non-EU establishment, and the reality of the cross-border supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document issued through DELTA/ECS)
Bill of Lading, CMR, or Air Waybill evidencing departure from France
Commercial Invoice and export sales contract
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank payment evidence from the non-EU customer
Récapitulatif d'expédition / Export Summary Listing (Article 302 CGI supporting records)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating exposes the taxable person to retrospective VAT assessment, late-payment interest equal to the ECB rate plus 5 percentage points (or 0.20% per month), a 40% negligence penalty, an 80% bad-faith penalty, and criminal sanctions for customs and tax fraud (Article 1741 CGI, Customs Code Article 414). The DGFiP may disallow the exemption if evidence of export is not produced within a reasonable deadline, typically 180 days, and may claw back the exempt VAT plus penalties and interest. Negligence in substantiation that results in an under-declaration may also trigger an ordinary tax audit with an extended three-year or six-year statute of limitations in fraud cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates a fully liberalized foreign exchange regime aligned with EU free movement of capital principles. Current account transactions, including profit remittances to non-resident shareholders, are freely convertible without restriction. Capital account transactions by French residents require mandatory declaration to the Banque de France for amounts exceeding €100,000 per transaction or €1 million annually. Profit remittances are unrestricted for EU-established entities provided full tax compliance, beneficial ownership verification, and AML/KYC standards are satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: French exporters are not subject to mandatory surrender or central bank conversion of export proceeds. Repatriation is permitted freely, with proceeds retainable offshore or returned to France. All export transactions above €15,000 require customs declaration; FX transactions above applicable thresholds must be reported to the Banque de France for statistical purposes only.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) authorized by the ACPR, such as PayPal or equivalent EU fintech platforms; legal constraints include compliance with the e-Money Directive, PSD2 payment services rules, and capital adequacy requirements for cross-border digital wallet operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors, legal representatives, or authorized signatories is mandatory for corporate account opening and full KYC interviews at French commercial banks; remote digital onboarding is not permitted for new SAS corporate accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening adverse hit or politically exposed person (PEP) status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed source-of-funds documentation, clean beneficial ownership chart, and independent legal opinion confirming compliance

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership structure opacity or unreconciled corporate documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified share register, director identification proofs, and updated KYC dossier with Banque de France declaration

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital from foreign investors routed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQTY'; verification requires submission of full KYC/AML dossier, beneficial ownership declaration, and Banque de France capital account reporting if applicable for French residents.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared via SWIFT MT103 referencing commercial invoice, purchase order, and delivery documents; Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) available through correspondent banking networks with purpose code 'TRAD'; all settlements subject to full AML verification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps and cross-currency basis swaps

Penalties of 0.2% per month of tax due, maximum 25%
